**Dishoom** is a chain of Indian restaurants based in [London](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/London "London"), England.[[2]](#cite_note-2) It was founded in 2010 by co-founders Shamil and Kavi Thakrar, along with Amar and Adarsh Radia, who both left the business in 2017. It was designed to match the [Irani cafés](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Irani_café "Irani café") popular in [Bombay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bombay "Bombay") in the 1960s.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Described by some as Indian [street food](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Street_food "Street food"), the restaurant describes its offering as Bombay comfort food with an evolving menu.[[4]](#cite_note-4) The menu includes breakfast [naan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naan_bread "Naan bread").[[5]](#cite_note-5)

The first Dishoom restaurant opened in 2010 in [Covent Garden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Covent_Garden "Covent Garden"), London. In 2023, the brand opened its first spin-off concept, Permit Room.[[6]](#cite_note-6) As of July 2025[[update]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Dishoom_(restaurant)&action=edit), the company operates 11 Dishoom restaurants across the UK and four Permit Room bars in [Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oxford "Oxford"), Cambridge, Brighton and [Notting Hill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Notting_Hill "Notting Hill").[[7]](#cite_note-7)

## Cookbook

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Dishoom_(restaurant)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Cookbook")]

In 2019, Dishoom published a cookbook with recipes for many of their popular dishes and cocktails, while also taking the reader on a tour of south Bombay.[[8]](#cite_note-8)

## Charity

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Dishoom_(restaurant)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Charity")]

For every meal Dishoom serves, it donates "a meal to a child who would otherwise go hungry". They work with the [charities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charitable_organization "Charitable organization") [Akshaya Patra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akshaya_Patra_Foundation "Akshaya Patra Foundation")[[25]](#cite_note-25) ([India](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India "India")) and Magic Breakfast[[26]](#cite_note-26) ([UK](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom "United Kingdom")), founded by [Carmel McConnell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carmel_McConnell "Carmel McConnell"). "Collectively, Magic Breakfast and Akshaya Patra serve 21.8 million children in England, Scotland and India." As of January 2025, Dishoom claims to have donated more than 20 million meals.[[27]](#cite_note-27)

# Dishoom

## Photos

[Dishoom](http://www.dishoom.com/) became an instant classic when it opened in 2009, right as Shoreditch’s beloved Brick Lane curry houses were becoming vintage stores and cocktail dens. The food at this all-day Indian joint is phenomenal—shrimp and chicken tandooris have a serious umami char; creamy black daals redefine comfort food; and pakoras and bhajis are fried to perfection—just like Mumbai grandmothers do it in the old country. And the décor has magic too. Channeling a turn-of-the-century Bombay coffee house, slow turning fans keep patrons cool as they eat spiced masalas at bentwood tables, and ceramic glasses are filled with fragrant chai as London scenesters and business people nosh breakfast naan sandwiches made with Ginger Pig bacon (trust us, a BLT back home just won’t compare afterwards). And now you no longer have to go East for its cheese naans and spinach gobi: There are [Dishooms](http://www.dishoom.com/) in [King's Cross](http://www.kingscrossnyc.org/), Soho and Covent Garden (we’ve tried them all, and yes the food measures up). But don’t think that’s eased the up-to two-hour wait which hit the Dishoom Shoreditch early on and never let up. The wait time, like the quality of the food, was exported to all, and reservations are only taken for parties of six and up. It helps that the staff hands out chai and Indian lemonades to those in line. But we—along with everyone else—would still be here even if they didn’t. *—Erin Florio*

## Each Dishoom is a love letter to Bombay – its food and its culture, its many varied people, its rich history and its endless eccentricities.

![](/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fdaku84np%2Fproduction%2F42163a6aeb9af4ea764220d37b3fcf7a5f428eac-1706x2560.jpg%3Ffit%3Dmax%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

**ABOVE:** The legendary B. Merwan on Bombay’s Grant Road dating from 1914

So many different voices from so many different places telling so many different stories joined together to become Bombay. It is a city of massive and juxtaposed extremes hemmed in tight by the ocean on three sides. And yet, past the crowds and between the layers of accumulated difference, there is magic. Hidden gems, lovely histories, the most delicious comfort food and countless stories to be told.

![](/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fdaku84np%2Fproduction%2F166e84c9df8561f3fbdb238eff2d7213220baca8-1200x1600.jpg%3Ffit%3Dmax%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

BOMBAY COMFORT FOOD

## Eat your way through the city

At Dishoom, you’ll find the food of all Bombay.

...its cafés, grills, street stalls and homes. This food evokes fond memories: the simple pleasure of sipping masala chai with buttered buns, the fire of a street-side Vada Pau and the snackery of Bhel, or the fragrant warmth of a potted Biryani shared with friends. Dishoom serves true Bombay comfort food inspired by its most treasured corners of the city.

CHRISTMAS FEASTING

## Rejoice in festive fare

Celebrate Christmas at Dishoom with **joyous, belly-filling feasts**. Devour plate after plate of first-rate splendour: Turkey Raan with all the trimmings. Crispy Parsnip & Kale Chaat. Cinnamon masal’d Chilli Sprouts. Plentiful Dishoom classics. Bottomless Tipsy Orange Cream Cake. Etc., etc., etc!

Pick your menu – Non-Veg., Veg. or Vegan, your server will take care of the perfect spread for the table.

*Available in all cafés: Monday 16th November – Thursday 24th December, from 12pm. For groups of four or more.*

Dishoom x Bungalow Feasting

**A sparkling Diwali union**

![](/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fdaku84np%2Fproduction%2F2290930794137b7c18f022752d1835dc52a080df-2048x1368.jpg%3Ffit%3Dmax%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

**Above:** Chef Arun and Chef Vikas

We’re thrilled to welcome our dear friend from New York – Michelin-starred chef and Bungalow restaurateur Vikas Khanna – to celebrate Diwali with us.

Gather loved ones for a **Dishoom x Bungalow Diwali Feast**: abundant vegetarian or vegan plates **for two or more to share**, dreamt up by Chef Vikas and our own Chef Arun, **for £30 per person**.

Bungalow’s beloved Spice Roasted Pineapple and Dishoom Makhani Kofta also grace the All Day menu as fleeting specials.

*In all cafés: 2nd –15th November, from 12pm.*

[#### Dishoom Leeds](/leeds/)

★ In 1930s and ’40s Bombay, a new generation of Indian architects imagined a brighter future. Along the Back Bay Reclamation, colourful Art Deco buildings rose in stylish defiance of the established order. Within lay modern-to-the-minute interiors full of glamour and possibility. Nearly a century later, Dishoom Leeds loudly celebrates this creative spirit of progress and reinvention on Vicar Lane.

Open all day, every day, serving Bombay comfort food for [breakfast](/leeds/breakfast-restaurant-leeds/), lunch, dinner and evening tipples. All are welcome.

[#### Dishoom Borough](/borough/)

1950s Bombay, Crawford Market. Everywhere: light, chatter, spices, fruits, vegetables and flowers in vivid displays. Loud calls from vendors proclaim the excellence of their wares. And beneath it all, a darker trade of hush-hush deals and *hafta*. It is in this world we lay our scene…  
  
Dishoom Borough comes to life amid the clamouring backdrop of Bombay’s Crawford Market, at **11–13 Park Street**. Open all day, every day, serving Bombay comfort food for breakfast, lunch, dinner and evening tipples. All are welcome.

[#### Dishoom Battersea](/battersea/)

Bombay, like Battersea, has hosted the dreams of an imagined future: in the grand visions of newly-independent Bombay; in the bold architecture of Battersea Power Station – each home to a brave, electric metropolis.

[Dishoom](/) Battersea is a tribute to the future-seekers behind these two areas. The story that sits behind the retro-futuristic design is that of a young girl in Bombay who is transported from 1953 to an imagined 2023, where she discovers superpowers. Open all day, every day, serving Bombay comfort food for [breakfast](/battersea/breakfast-restaurant-battersea/), [lunch](/battersea/lunch-restaurant-battersea/), dinner and evening tipples. All are welcome.

[#### Dishoom Canary Wharf](/canary-wharf/)

It’s 1973. Opposite the Bombay Stock Exchange, a newly refreshed café swells with exquisitely made modern-style furniture and newly painted art. The café is the swishest in town, pinned against a backdrop of towering promise, opportunity, fortune. And loss.

Nestled in a little corner of Wood Wharf, our most fine and gorgeous Dishoom Canary Wharf brings to life the glittering-shimmering, big-business, metropolitan scene of ‘70s Bombay. Open all day, every day, serving Bombay comfort food for [breakfast](/canary-wharf/breakfast-restaurant-canary-wharf/), [lunch](/canary-wharf/lunch-restaurant-canary-wharf/), dinner and evening tipples. [#### Dishoom Carnaby](/carnaby/)

...what a terrific trip! In the ‘60s, young Indians started hankering after Western styles. ‘Beat’ bands in Bombay belted out versions of the latest rock’n’roll hits. A whirlwind of excitement shook both London and Bombay.

Dishoom Carnaby – and its accompanying vinyl ‘Slip Disc’ – shares this little-known intersection of time, place and culture. Open all day, every day, serving Bombay comfort food for [breakfast](/carnaby/breakfast-restaurant-carnaby/), [lunch](/carnaby/lunch-restaurant-carnaby/), dinner and evening tipples. The thrill and amazement of the Talkies era is captured within ‘New’ [Dishoom](/) Covent Garden. Dishoom King’s Cross found a home in an old Victorian industrial building and tells the story of Indian Independence through its design and artwork. All are welcome.

[#### Dishoom Birmingham](/birmingham/)

Freedom through trade. Bombay, like Birmingham, is a city of a thousand trades. Through its markets and manufacturers, craftsmen and commerce, India forged a proud new identity built on the principle of Swadeshi (self-reliance), and gained its independence.

At [Dishoom](/) Birmingham, we pay homage to all who laboured for India’s freedom. Open all day, every day, serving Bombay comfort food for [breakfast](/birmingham/breakfast-restaurant-birmingham/), [lunch](/birmingham/lunch-restaurant-birmingham/), dinner and evening tipples. All are welcome.

[#### Dishoom Edinburgh](/edinburgh/)

Scottish botanist, sociologist and town planner Patrick Geddes (1854–1932) was invited to Bombay in 1915. While there, he founded the department of Sociology & Civics at Bombay University, and continually sought to better society by improving civic facilities and creating shared environments.

At Dishoom Edinburgh, we pay tribute to Geddes’ big-hearted character, his visionary thinking and his humanist ideals. Open all day, every day, serving Bombay comfort food for [breakfast](/edinburgh/breakfast-restaurant-edinburgh/), [lunch](/edinburgh/lunch-restaurant-edinburgh/), dinner and evening tipples. All are welcome.

[#### Dishoom Manchester](/manchester/)

Circling crows caw and the smell of spice, jasmine and dust mix outside the Lodge Rising Star of Western India. Founded in Bombay in 1843, the first Indian Masonic Lodge had Manockjee Cursetjee as the pioneering first member.

Today, the Lodge meets in Bombay’s Freemasons’ Hall, where Bro. Cursetjee’s portrait hangs on the wall, watchfully. Through [Dishoom](/) Manchester – itself built within a former Freemasons’ Hall – we hope to share a glimpse of Freemasonry in Bombay.

Tim Wendelboe Oslo.content:
Located at Grünersgate 1 at Grünerløkka in Oslo, this espresso bar is visited by locals and tourists from all over the world. Tim Wendelboe is perceived as a coffee showroom where people can be inspired to try something new, or see the world of coffee in a different light. It is a place to enjoy a nice cup of freshly brewed coffee by yourself or to try coffee tasting together with a friend. Located at Grünersgate 1 at Grünerløkka in Oslo, this espresso bar is visited by locals and tourists from all over the world. Tim Wendelboe is perceived as a coffee showroom where people can be inspired to try something new, or see the world of coffee in a different light. It is a place to enjoy a nice cup of freshly brewed coffee by yourself or to try coffee tasting together with a friend.

They offer a seasonal menu of coffees brewed to order and a small range of espresso based drinks with or without milk. The menu changes according to coffee harvest seasons and the local weather. # Coffee Tasting and Roastery Tour

#### Location: Tøyengata 29c, Oslo

Join our coffee tasting and roastery tour to explore the world of coffee. You will taste different coffees from different origins and learn how we at Tim Wendelboe highlight the natural flavours of coffee.

As part of the event you will take part in a cupping session – a method of brewing and tasting coffee that allows us to closely analyse and compare its flavour, aroma, and mouthfeel.

We will also give you a tour of our roastery, where you will get an inside look at how we work. During the tour, we will guide you through the different steps of the roasting process.

No prior knowledge or experience is required. This course is for anyone who loves coffee and wants to learn more.

#### $72.00 per person

---

[View full details](/products/coffee-tasting-and-roastery-tour)

## About the tour

* **Date:** View calendar in the "Book your tour" button above
* **Language**: English
* **Duration**: Up to 1.5 hours

#### Location

* The tour is held at out roastery and lab in Tøyengata 29c, Oslo, **not at the espressobar.**

* We are located on the second floor, with access to elevator. Please feel free to let us know about any accessibility needs or if you have questions regarding this.

### Additional information

Please note that your booking is binding, and the full fee applies even if you’re unable to attend, as your place is reserved especially for you. Rescheduling must be done at least 48 hours before the event.

We will have regular coffee courses with up to 12 participants twice a month. For group bookings (up to 15 participants) you can use the chat or e-mail us at hello@timwendelboe.no

[![](//timwendelboe.no/cdn/shop/files/tim-w-lab-2_kopi.webp?v=1762865375&width=2000)](/products/gift-card-coffee-tasting-and-roastery-tour)

## Roastery Tour Gift Card

**Would you like to give the Coffee Tasting & Roastery Tour as a gift?**

With this giftcard the receiver can choose the date and time which suits them best and book a ticket. You will also have the option to download a digital card to give.

[Buy Gift Card](/products/gift-card-coffee-tasting-and-roastery-tour)

# Inside the Roastery at Tim Wendelboe in Oslo, Norway (behind the scenes tour)
## Channel: Roaster Kat
22.6K subscribers
472 likes

### Description
19,173 views
Posted: 2025-07-12
Going behind the scenes at Norway's legendary Tim Wendelboe kaffebrenneriet (coffee roastery) in Oslo. We get a tour from Daniel (and two cameos from Tim himself!) of their small but mighty (and tidy) space - cupping lab, cold storage, and roastery. He walks through how their team goes from cup to outgoing bag on one of the busiest days of the year, subscription fulfillment day.

Located at Grünersgate 1 at Grünerløkka in Oslo, this espresso bar is visited by locals and tourists from all over the world. Tim Wendelboe is perceived as a coffee showroom where people can be inspired to try something new, or see the world of coffee in a different light. It is a place to enjoy a nice cup of freshly brewed coffee by yourself or to try coffee tasting together with a friend. [...] They offer a seasonal menu of coffees brewed to order and a small range of espresso based drinks with or without milk. The menu changes according to coffee harvest seasons and the local weather. You can of course buy their freshly roasted coffee beans to take home and get brewing advice from the experienced baristas.

 The Europe’s Best Coffee Shops 2026, sponsored by Slayer Espresso

Located at Grünersgate 1 at Grünerløkka in Oslo, this espresso bar is visited by locals and tourists from all over the world. Tim Wendelboe is perceived as a coffee showroom where people can be inspired to try something new, or see the world of coffee in a different light. It is a place to enjoy a nice cup of freshly brewed coffee by yourself or to try coffee tasting together with a friend.

They offer a seasonal menu of coffees brewed to order and a small range of espresso based drinks with or without milk. The menu changes according to coffee harvest seasons and the local weather. You can of course buy their freshly roasted coffee beans to take home and get brewing advice from the experienced baristas.

# Huckleberry — Bakery, Café, Catering

![Bread and Pastries Display](https://www.huckleberrycafe.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Huckleberry_06.16.23_13-1024x683.jpg)

# huckleberry bakery & cafe

Huckleberry is THE Santa Monica Farmers’ Market bakery, café and marketplace that’s a one-stop destination for beautiful pastries, artisan coffee, gourmet provisions and a casual breakfast or lunch. We’re a living expression of the hard work and beauty that the local farmers provide us, and we’ve become a beloved, neighborhood gathering place since opening in 2009.

# THANKSGIVING CATERING

![](https://www.huckleberrycafe.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/IMG_2036-2-1024x487.jpg)

This year, we’re welcoming a new chef and a refreshed Thanksgiving menu, bringing a little something new to the table while keeping the dishes that make the holiday itself something to be grateful for.

We’re starting with **Milo + Olive breads and a whole new lineup of spreads**: from Cranberry Walnut Goat Cheese and Whipped Pumpkin Butter to Vegan Spinach & Artichoke Dip. Add a box of our house-made cornbread, pull-apart brioche rolls, or buttermilk biscuits, and you might find yourself filling up before dinner even starts.

For the main event, there’s **Mary’s Free Range Turkey with all the fixings**: slow-simmered gravy, Braised Leek & Celery Stuffing, our very special “Marry Me” Mashed Potatoes, Baked Mac & Cheese, Sweet Potato Casserole, Blistered Haricot Vert, Autumn Harvest Salad, and Cranberry Sauce.

And for your second dessert stomach: **Pumpkin Pie, Chocolate Pecan Pie, Apple Tarte Tatin, Turkey-Shaped Ginger Cookies**, and **Sweet Rose Creamery** **Ice Cream**.

Let Huckleberry handle dinner. You handle the people, the politics, and the inevitable leftovers, which, naturally, we’ve prepared for with a next-day Leftover Sandwich Kit.

***Thanksgiving orders are available for pickup on Thanksgiving Day, with orders closing Thursday, November 19 at 6pm.***

## Papa d’Amour is now open in NYC!

We love blending cultures, techniques, and memories in the world of pastry. And we all know that when Papa is in the kitchen, there are no rules.

A San Francisco original since 2005, world famous and a local favorite, we’re a fully independent and woman-owned coffee roasting company.

We’ve been purchasing coffee directly from the farmers who grow it since 2007, when we were just a tiny, one cafe operation.

We’ve always roasted our coffees in small batches, and taste every roast because we’re obsessed with quality. We’re also a pioneer of the West Coast style of light roasting that continues to illuminate the spectrum of what coffee can be.

# About Us

##### Hi There! We’re Ritual Coffee Roasters

Of course coffee’s our thing. We set the highest standard for quality and sustainable sourcing in the industry.

But despite our mad-scientist pursuit of the perfect cup, we’re determined to demystify the entire coffee experience.

## Sourcing our Coffees

Finding the gems buried in one of the world’s most actively traded commodities isn’t easy. Ritual pays double to triple the commodity market value for specialty grade coffees, and far above “fair trade” prices as well.

We pride ourselves in sourcing coffees from smallholder farmers whom we know. By paying sustainable base prices, providing financial incentives for hitting quality targets, and investing in special infrastructure improvement projects, the producers we partner with are able to earn more for their coffee and reinvest money back into their farms.

Standout coffee producers share the same attitude about their craft as we do: that coffee can always be better.

## Eileen Rinaldi, Founder

Eileen once had a shot of espresso that changed her life. She was at a cafe called Vivace in Seattle, and knew right then what she must do. Open a shop, dedicated solely to coffee, in her favorite city. She founded Ritual in 2005.

Fast forward years later, and she’s built a totally unique, passionate enterprise, while at the same time helping foster the careers of so many on the vanguard.

When she’s not hanging out with her daughter Alice and son Edsel, she’s still hard at work caring for Ritual – though she’ll be the first to tell you her door is always open, and she almost always has time for coffee. Come say hi!

## Our Values

##### BE KIND

Being nice is never the exception to the rule. It’s just as important to us as making the best coffee.

##### HAVE FUN

Our tireless pursuit of the perfect cup will never keep us from having fun along the way.

##### BE INCLUSIVE

Coffee is for everyone. We create a safe, welcoming environment on both sides of the counter.

##### HAVE INTEGRITY

We build win-win relationships with everyone we work with and treat them as an extension of Ritual.

##### CHALLENGE THE STATUS QUO

We don’t pretend to have it all figured out. It’s part of who we are and we like it that way. We’ll always try to make the Ritual experience even better.

##### STAY GROUNDED

Even though we’re at the top of our game, we’ll never have an attitude about it.

## Our History

* ##### 2023

  Launching a line of delicious canned coffees!

  ![3 canned coffees on wooden table](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/2023.09.29-Ritual-Coffee_RTD_New-Labels_Joseph-Weaver_10402-600x480.jpg)
* ##### 2022

  Ritual opened a café in the Harvey Milk Terminal (Terminal 1B) at San Francisco International Airport.

  ![Exterior of Ritual SFO](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/ritual-sfo-026-final-web_52810595268_o-600x400.jpg)
* ##### 2020

  We update our packaging design and unveil this entirely new website, whilst working to stay afloat during a global pandemic.

  ![red cup](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/50019972213_19cca344ca_k-600x400.jpg)
* ##### 2019

  Ace “omniroast” single-origin coffee line is introduced, suitable for both espresso and drip preparations.

  ![ace bag](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/DSC04500_2-scaled-e1603770451677-600x446.jpg)
* ##### 2018

  Ritual dips a toe in the instant coffee world, then jumps in altogether.

  ![coffee tubes](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/instant3-593x600.jpg)
* ##### 2017

  Ritual Napa expands to include the Cup & Star Bar, a sit-down experiential coffee bar with a special menu.

  ![cup and star bar interior](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/cup-star-bar-600x398.jpg)
* Ritual’s 6th location opens in the heart of San Francisco, on Market Street in the Castro.

  ![Say yes to coffee window decal](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/say-yes-to-coffee-scaled-e1603326965620-600x440.jpg)
* ##### 2016

  Our branding is updated, along with new bio-friendly packaging and custom “belly band” labels. We win an award or two.

  ![Ritual rebrand](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/riutal-rebrand-600x399.png)
* We take Ritual baristas to Finca Monte Rey in rural El Salvador to learn about how coffee is produced, and to then try their hand at picking some.

  ![coffee pickers](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/25603529415_edd02d903d_k-600x400.jpg)
* Ritual Haight opens at the quintessentially San Francisco corner of Haight and Central, diagonally across from Buena Vista Park and a row of gorgeous Edwardians.

  ![Ritual on Haight](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/haightsignsquare-scaled-e1603327554877-600x398.jpg)
* ##### 2015

  Ritual introduces a matching 401k plan for employees.

  ![two matching cups](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/1716604342-600x308.jpg)
* ##### 2014

  Ritual’s flagship on Valencia gets a major remodel, making the space more open and light.

  ![remodel of valencia cafe](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Valenciaoutsidevivid-600x429.jpg)
* First staff origin trip to Honduras, nicknamed “Baristas in Paradise.” Employees get to meet several coffee producers we work with and see firsthand how coffee is cultivated and processed.

  ![honduras staff](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/14964251124_1829b11730_o-600x600.jpg)
* ##### 2013

  Our coffee bags get redesigned.

  ![2012 bag design](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/12/Bag-Photo-2-600x400.jpeg)
* ##### 2011

  Ritual Hayes Valley opens in a custom built, repurposed shipping container, one of the first in North America!

  ![ritual hayes](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2011/12/Matthew-Millman_PROXY_SF-1146-600x401.jpg)
* ##### 2010

  We ditch the French Press in favor of Hario V-60 individual pour-overs, and everyone else has since copied us!

  ![making v60 pourovers](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/making-v60-pourovers-600x400.jpg)
* We switch from roasting on a 1990’s Probat L-12 to a far superior fully-retrofitted 1950’s Probat UG-22

  ![coffee roaster](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2010/06/49166372607_47b679a131_k-3-543x600.jpg)
* ##### 2009

  Eileen is a founding member of SF Made, alongside Mark Dwight of Rickshaw Bagworks.

  ![](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2009/12/SFMade-logo-574x600.jpg)
* Ritual opens its very own production Roastery and training center in the SoMa neighborhood

  ![people standing around a cupping table](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/dandicup-scaled-e1603328333734-600x413.jpg)
* ##### 2008

  Coffee in Wine Country – Napa’s Oxbow Public Market gets its very own outpost of Ritual

  ![napa oxbow with ritual flag](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/napa-oxbow-e1603328483197-600x345.jpg)
* ##### 2007

  Ritual opens a kiosk in the Bayview, tucked inside the equally revolutionary Flora Grubb Gardens

  ![Ritual at flora grubb](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/ritual-at-flora-grubb-600x400.jpg)
* Under coffee buyer Ryan Brown, Ritual begins its relationship-based sourcing model

  ![](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2007/09/Untitled-5.png)
* ##### 2006

  We start roasting on a little 5 kilo Probat in the back of the Valencia Street café.

  ![](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2006/05/Untitled-4-460x600.png)
* ##### 2005

  We open our first café on Valencia Street and introduce San Francisco to the style of coffee that it’s now known for. By day 3, we already have a line to the corner.

  ![Cafe on Valencia at night](https://ritualcoffee.com/wp-content/uploads/2005/05/valencia-cafe-at-dark-600x400.jpg)

Gamaliel Ríos Ortíz is a third-generation coffee producer in Chiapas.

El Castaño, his farm, sits between 1400-1700 meters above sea level along the Sierra Madre de Chiapas mountain range. There, he grows Typica and Peñasco varieties, fermented for around 90 hours, and red honey processed, creating a full-bodied, fruit-forward, juicy coffee.

# “Sweet Tooth” Espresso Nano Genji

$25.00 – $171.00Price range: $25.00 through $171.00

[← Previous](https://ritualcoffee.com/shop/coffee/santa-lucia-costa-rica/)

[Next →](https://ritualcoffee.com/shop/coffee/sweet-tooth-espresso-sochiapam/)

The anti-blend made for espresso adventurers, our Sweet Tooth offering changes several times throughout the year.

Nano Genji represents the coffee harvest of over 800 small producers in Jimma, Ethiopia. Jimma is divided into several woredas (districts) and kebeles (communities) with washing stations throughout—each offering unique terroir. The Geera woreda is one of them, and within it lies the Genji Challa kebele, housing the Nano Genji washing station. In the Nano Genji washing station, the coffees are washed and mechanically depulped, then soaked overnight. After fermentation, coffee is dried for 6 to 8 hours a day over 6 to 8 days on raised beds, with frequent turning for even drying. A beautifully delicate coffee, Nano Genji has notes of black tea, honey, and crisp green apple.

From Co-Founder + Executive Chairman Brett Smith...

## We’ve been doing this for a while and we won’t stop.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/1995.png?v=1730147027)

1995

After meeting at the UNC Kenan-Flagler Business School, Brett Smith and Fred Houk founded Counter Culture Coffee. Our first sale was a bag of coffee to Pop’s Trattoria.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/1997.png?v=1730147179)

1997

We launched Sanctuary, a bird-friendly coffee line, at the 1997 Specialty Coffee Association of America event in New Orleans. We were among the first roasters to offer shade-grown coffee.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2002.png?v=1730147258)

2002

Our Durham facility became the first organic-certified coffee roaster in North Carolina. We held our first public tasting on a Friday morning, which initiated a tradition that continues today: Tasting at Ten.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2003.png?v=1730147275)

2003

We formalized our commitment to real social, environmental, and financial sustainability in the Counter Culture vision statement. This document was signed by Brett Smith, Peter Giuliano, and Daryn Berlin on March 10, 2003.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2004.png?v=1730147344)

2004

We took our first customer group to visit coffee farms in Nicaragua—a precursor to our annual Origin Field Lab event.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2007.png?v=1730147359)

2007

We launched our Source coffees: 12 oz bags focused on single-origin coffees. That year, the Source line won Best New Product at the annual Specialty Coffee Association of America conference.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2008.png?v=1730147376)

2008

We established our certified Direct Trade policy, paving the way for our current coffee-buying model.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2009.png?v=1730147407)

2009

We published our first Transparency Report, detailing Direct Trade purchases of twelve coffees in the previous year.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2010.png?v=1730147482)

2010

We created our Seeds program to structure and define our monetary contributions to projects that benefit our coffee-producing partners and their communities. We also obtained a Green Plus sustainable business certification.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2012.png?v=1730146492)

2012

We became a founding member of the Coalition for Coffee Communities, an organization established to address food security issues in coffee communities and promote collaboration among competitors. Additionally, we received the Green Plus Sustainable Enterprise of the Year award.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2015.png?v=1730146443)

2015

Drawing upon two decades of expertise, we opened a new roastery and training center in the San Francisco Bay area. This strategic move not only enhanced our ability to cater to our West Coast partners but also significantly reduced the environmental footprint associated with shipping our products throughout the region

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2016.png?v=1730146241)

2016

We moved our Headquarters to a new facility near downtown Durham, NC. We became the first specialty coffee roaster to deploy color-sorting technology for roasted  
coffee. This machine eliminates coffee outside of a desired color profile, helping to create a  
higher quality product for our partners.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2018.png?v=1730145968)

2018

After over two years of research by many members of the Counter Culture team, we published our first book, *A Reference Guide to Ethiopian Coffee Varieties,* by Getu Bekele and Tim Hill. After five years of research and development, we led our first Climate Change Adaptation Workshops series.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2020.png?v=1730145698)

2020

After an extensive application process, we became a certified B Corp. We appointed a Board of Directors to guide and improve business strategy. We launched our seventh year-round coffee, Gradient, to fill an identified hole in our core menu.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2021.png?v=1730145620)

2021

We started using an open-book management system: the Great Game of Business. This financial transparency allows employees to work together and build a better, more financially sustainable company. We rolled out free, incentivized stock options to all full-time employees.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2022.png?v=1730145849)

2022

We reorganized our Durham warehouse to sustain the company’s growth. This change included overhauling the floorplan, installing a rotary bag filling-and-sealing machine, implementing spray printing, modifying 5lb wholesale film supplies, and utilizing larger bag pallets.

![](//counterculturecoffee.com/cdn/shop/files/2023.png?v=1730145920)

2023

We launched our Bloom program, which provides grants for sustainability projects proposed by our wholesale partners. After years of innovation, we debuted Cubed, a super coffee concentrate.

## Wholesale Benefits

Onyx has always been industry focused, from the producers to the cafes. We’ve built a team and benefit packages based on a combination of many long careers running coffee programs, cafes and restaurants. We know what we would want from a partnership, and that’s precisely what we bring to the table. Benefit from what we know and what we can offer you. We look forward to working together.

[Great Coffee](#great-coffee) [World Class Training](#world-class-training) [Customer Service](#customer-service) [Tech Support](#tech-support) [Consulting](#consulting) [Culture & Partnership](#culture-partnership)

### Great Coffee

A quality coffee beverage starts all the way back at the farm. From its inception, every step along the supply chain influences the characteristics of the final cup. We know that building a successful business requires this same kind of intentionality. Our coffees set you up to produce drinks that customers love, and our strict quality control process means that we only send out the absolute best coffees we roast. On top of everything else, our commitment to pricing and logistics transparency means that you have access to all the data we do, granting you full access to a wealth of knowledge and resources you can trust.

### World Class Training

We take a lot of pride in our training program at Onyx. Our trainers have all excelled greatly in the world of coffee, from winning national titles in brewing to international titles in latte art. Beyond these competitive achievements, however, they are simply phenomenal coffee professionals, able to break down complex brew theory into digestible, enjoyable lessons. Together, our trainers have had a hand in the creation of incredible baristas. For our partners we offer on site, virtual, and on campus training at our HQ at the 1907. From basic espresso theory to training trainers, we can do it all.

### Customer Service

To many companies, customer service is simply a requisite to full–to us, it is our top concern. Not only do we desire intentional and fruitful relationships with every partner, big and small, but we strive to offer extremely quick and efficient services. We truly believe our success is only found in the success of those with whom we work, so we will do whatever we can to help you and your shop reach your goals.

### Tech Support

The importance of properly functioning machinery cannot be overstated. Whether it’s equipment recommendations, regular maintenance or an emergency repair, we offer support for wholesale customers and other shops alike. We work on and support most major coffee equipment brands. Expertise and passion for coffee combine with excellence and customer service.

### Consulting

So much of hospitality, customer experience, and staff efficiency begins with thoughtful design. Whether it’s guidance on purchasing coffee equipment or MEP layout on your coffee bar, our team has the experience to provide in depth feedback on your project. Our goal is to help set our partners up to offer the very best high end coffee service.

### Culture & Partnership

We’re an independently owned company that wants to see grassroots coffee grow. No investors to please, just us. We want to see independent cafes flourish. Whether it's social media support or hanging out at a coffee event, we’re committed to relationships and to excellence and we truly thrive whenever our partners are successful.

# Your Privacy Choices

We use cookies and similar technologies to run the shop, remember what
you put in the cart, measure how the site is used, and attribute orders
to the ads or links that brought you here. You are opted in to analytics
and marketing cookies by default. Essential cookies stay on so checkout,
accounts, and security keep working.

This page is how you opt out of analytics, marketing, advertising, and
the sale or sharing of personal information. The preference is stored
in a first-party cookie on this device for one year. You can come back
and change it anytime.

## Analytics, marketing, and data sharing

You are opted in. Analytics, marketing, and data sharing are on.

Your browser is sending a Global Privacy Control signal, so this
preference stays opted out.

## What stays on

Essential cookies and similar storage keep the cart, checkout, login,
localization, and fraud prevention working. Those are not optional.
Opting out here does not log you out or empty your cart.

## What you can turn off

When you are opted in we may use analytics and advertising cookies,
click IDs, and similar identifiers (including tools such as Shopify
analytics, Meta, Google, and Klaviyo) to measure campaigns, remember
how you arrived at the site, and send that attribution through with
an order. Some of that sharing can qualify as a “sale” or “share” of
personal information under U.S. state privacy laws.

Opting out tells us not to use those technologies for analytics,
marketing, or data sharing on this browser. It also records a Do Not
Sell or Share preference with Shopify so pixels that honor that
signal should stop. It does not reach every third party on the
internet, and it does not delete history they already have.

## Global Privacy Control

If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal, we treat
that as an opt-out of sale or sharing and of our analytics and
marketing cookies. You do not need to use the toggle in that case.

# A taste of holiday magic

![Latte topped with whipped cream and chocolate curls in a holiday cup. ](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_PeppermintMocha_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## Peppermint Mocha

The classic returns with its perfect dark-chocolate curls. Handcrafted with rich mocha, sweet peppermint and a little extra joy.

[Order now](/menu/product/496/hot)

![Latte topped with whipped cream and caramel brulée bits in a holiday cup.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_CaramelBruleeLatte_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## Caramel Brulée Latte

Rejoice, brulée is back! Our decadent caramel brulée sauce and signature crunchy topping made this an instant holiday favorite.

[Order now](/menu/product/517/hot)

![Iced latte topped with cold foam and cocoa powder in a glass.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_IcedTiramisuVelvetLatte_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Iced Tiramisu Velvet Latte

Inspired by the irresistible Italian treat. Our signature espresso and milk flavored with vanilla, then finished with velvet mascarpone cold foam and rich cocoa.

[Order now](/menu/product/2121215/iced)

![ Hot latte topped with cold foam and cocoa powder in a glass mug.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_TiramisuVelvetLatte_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Tiramisu Velvet Latte

A hot take on our newest dessert-inspired drink. Bold espresso, steamed milk and notes of vanilla meet indulgent layers of velvet mascarpone cold foam and cocoa.

[Order now](/menu/product/2121215/hot)

![Iced latte topped with red and green sprinkles in a glass.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_IcedSugarCookieLatte_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## Iced Sugar Cookie Latte

A holiday tradition on ice. Our signature espresso and creamy milk with sugar cookie syrup and red and green sprinkles.

[Order now](/menu/product/28516/iced)

![Iced matcha latte topped with cold foam and red and green sprinkles in a glass.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_IcedSugarCookieCreamMatcha_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Iced Sugar Cookie Cream Matcha

This year, matcha joins the fun. Our smooth, creamy matcha latte with sugar cookie cream cold foam and a merry mix of sprinkles.

[Order now](/menu/product/28313/iced)

![Iced green drink with red popping pearls.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_ApplePomegranateLemonadeRefresher_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Apple Pomegranate Lemonade Refresher

Cool, bright and festive. Notes of crisp apple shaken with lemonade and ice atop pomegranate-flavored popping pearls.

[Order now](/menu/product/41056/iced)

![Iced green drink with coconutmilk and red popping pearls.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_SnowyAppleDrink_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Snowy Apple Drink

Little pops of pomegranate-flavored joy adorn a cheerful apple-flavored Refresher shaken with creamy coconutmilk and ice.

[Order now](/menu/product/41060/iced)

![Iced chai latte with cold foam and spice topping in a glass.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_IcedGingerbreadCreamChai_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## Iced Gingerbread Cream Chai

Warm chai spices made creamy and iced. Finished with a layer of gingerbread cream cold foam and a dusting of spice topping.

[Order now](/menu/product/28520/iced)

![Hot chai latte in a mug.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_CaramelBruleeChai_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Caramel Brulée Chai

Cozy chai and rich caramel brulée sauce are a match made in holiday heaven. Sprinkled with crunchy caramel brulée bits.

[Order now](/menu/product/41183/hot)

![A chocolaty cake pop decorated to resemble the Starbucks Bearista Bear.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_BearistaCakePop_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Bearista™ Cake Pop

Inspired by our Starbucks® Bearista™ Tumbler. Vanilla cake, buttercream frosting and chocolaty icing in one iconic cake pop.

[Order now](/menu/product/40739/single)

![A fluffy danish filled with cream cheese and a sugar-plum spread.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_SugarPlumCheeseDanish_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## Sugar Plum Cheese Danish

We turned visions of sugar plums into a fluffy danish filled with cream cheese and spiced sugar-plum spread. Here for the holidays.

[Order now](/menu/product/2122869/single)

![An iced snowman sugar cookie on a serving platter.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_Snowman Cookie_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## Snowman Cookie

Jolly, happy and oh, so adorable. Buttery shortbread dressed in white icing, winter accessories and sugar that sparkles like snow.

[Order now](/menu/product/2122532/single)

![A grouping of Cranberry Bliss Bars on a wood surface.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_CranberryBlissBar_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## Cranberry Bliss® Bar

A blondie cake with dried cranberries, finished with cream-cheese icing flecked with orange zest—and an extra touch of cranberry bliss.

[Order now](/menu/product/2121590/Single)

![A grilled cheese with braised short rib on a glass plate.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_BraisedShortRibGrilledCheese_FeaturedMenu_IMG-1)

## New Braised Short Rib Grilled Cheese

A heartier take on our classic grilled cheese. Elevated with braised short rib, caramelized onion jam and a hint of dijon.

[Order now](https://www.starbucks.com/menu/product/40734/single)

![A turkey sandwich with stuffing on a glass plate.](https://cloudassets.starbucks.com/is/image/sbuxcorp/001_TurkeyStuffingSandwich_FeaturedMenu_IMG)

## New Turkey & Stuffing Sandwich

A Thanksgiving-inspired favorite. Sliced turkey, stuffing, gravy and cranberry sauce on a cranberry-studded baguette.

[Order now](https://www.starbucks.com/menu/product/873068674/single)

# Allergen and Nutrition Information

We have menu variations, so please be sure to check the specific nutrition and allergen information for your menu items through online ordering for your bakery-cafe and/or ask a manager at your bakery-cafe.

**Effective 9/2/2026**

·        [View Our Allergen Guide Here](https://www.panerabread.com/content/dam/panerabread/documents/c8-26-allergen-guide.pdf)

·        [View Our Nutrition (Including Sugar) + Caffeine Guide Here](https://www.panerabread.com/content/dam/panerabread/documents/c8-26-nutrition-guide.pdf)

## Learn More About Allergens

Many of our products contain or may come into contact with common allergens, including wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, shellfish and sesame.

Our bakery-cafe and catering menus vary by location due to, among other things, market tests and local requirements. If you have an allergy concern, please ask a manager at your bakery-cafe to check the ingredient listing for specific menu items. Please note that we cannot guarantee that any of our menu items are free of allergens because we use shared equipment and handle common allergens throughout our supply chain and bakery-cafe. To find out about allergens in our Panera At Home™ consumer packaged products, please see the detailed ingredient listing on the applicable packaging or the Panera At Home page on PaneraBread.com.

Please note that the customization functionality of this Site does not identify common allergens for added ingredients or delete references to allergens for removed ingredients.

MA Notice: Before placing your order, please inform your server if a person in your party has a food allergy.

Canada Notice: Many of our products also contain or may come into contact with common allergens, including sulfites, sesame and mustard.

### For a Full List of Ingredients

Our bakery-cafe and catering menus may vary by location due to, among other things, market tests and local requirements. For a full list of ingredients for most bakery-cafe menu items, please go to the menu item listed on PaneraBread.com. If you have a question about ingredients in a specific menu item, please ask a manager at your bakery-cafe to check the ingredient listing for that item. To learn more about nutrition for our Panera At Home™ consumer packaged products, please see the detailed ingredient listing on the applicable packaging or the Panera At Home pages on PaneraBread.com.

### About Our Nutrition Information

Nutritional information provided on this Site about our standard bakery-cafe and catering menu items is based on Panera's standardized recipes, representative values provided by suppliers, analysis using industry standard software, published resources, and/or testing conducted in accredited laboratories, and are expressed in values based on federal rounding and other applicable regulations. A number of factors may affect the actual nutrition values for each product and, as such, Panera cannot guarantee the complete accuracy of the nutritional information provided on this Site, on PaneraBread.com or in our bakery-cafes.

For our US bakery-cafes, nutrition information for our standard bakery-cafe and most catering menu items can be found on our [United States Nutrition Information Guide PDF](https://www.panerabread.com/content/dam/panerabread/documents/c8-26-nutrition-guide.pdf "US nutrition") on panerabread.com and our US catering page. Check back often for updates. Nutrition information about our Panera At Home™ consumer packaged products is available on the product packaging and on the Panera At Home™ pages on PaneraBread.com.

Panera does not endorse or make any specific representations, claims or advice about any particular eating lifestyle or diet. Any information provided by Panera is for general informational purposes only and is not intended to be a substitute for medical advice. Consult with your physician, registered dietitian or other health professional if you have questions or concerns about your health, diet and/or specific nutritional needs.

# There's something special about Krispy Kreme Doughnuts

![Image 5: Collage of guests enjoying Krispy Kreme doughnuts](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/9tlw6prn/production/85c9460f8e42b06fcdeff2d4cf8325cc03d1973d-702x251.png?fm=webp&w=768&fit=min)

### OUR MISSION

To make the most awesome doughnuts on the planet every single day.

### OUR COMMUNITY

Giving back to our communities through fundraising and philanthropic work is at our core.

### OUR BELIEF

Things are better enjoyed together, especially the fresh fluffy clouds of deliciousness we call doughnuts.

![Image 6: Two Original Glazed Doughnuts and Hot Light](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/9tlw6prn/production/184d1583839328a8c0d67f5cd68987898c546dad-717x1025.png?auto=format&fit=min)

## Fun.Fresh. Warm.

Since 1937, Krispy Kreme has been delivering joy one doughnut at a time—starting with our world-famous Original Glazed®, known for its hot-off-the-line, melt-in-your-mouth experience. What began as a small shop in Winston-Salem, North Carolina has grown into one of the most beloved doughnut brands around the globe, now proudly headquartered in both Winston-Salem and Charlotte. Today, there are more ways than ever to experience the magic of Krispy Kreme. You can order online for convenient pickup or delivery, visit us in-shop to see the doughnuts being made fresh, or grab a sweet pick-me-up from select retailers offering single doughnuts and 6-packs. Hosting a birthday, office party, or community event? Our catering and fundraising options make it easy to share the joy. And for our most devoted fans, becoming a Krispy Kreme Rewards member means exclusive access to offers, special treats, and even a free doughnut just for signing up. No matter how you doughnut—on the go, with friends, or as a midday pick-me-up—Krispy Kreme is here to make life a little sweeter, one delicious bite at a time.

## About Us

We source and roast coffee from single farms, estates and cooperatives. When we taste a coffee that we like, we want to know where it comes from and who grows, picks and processes it. We travel extensively throughout the year, visiting the producers and cooperatives with whom we currently work and looking for interesting cultivars of coffee and new farms from which to buy. During these visits we talk with farmers, learning more about the coffee they grow and process and the challenges that they face. We then look to establish a relationship with the grower and exporter of that coffee. We believe that where such a relationship exists, quality, quantity and price requirements can be discussed in an open and equal way. We see this as sustainable, fair and equal trade.

# Privacy Policy

## Overview

Monmouth Coffee Company Limited (“we”, “us” or “our”) consider your privacy to be of utmost importance and we will always hold and process your information in accordance with data protection laws.

By using our website you are agreeing to be bound by our privacy policy. We may change this policy occasionally to keep up to date with regulations, to improve clarity or to address any procedural changes relating to internal data handling. We will make significant changes clear but we will not contact you directly to inform you of updates. You are responsible for reading the policy from time to time.

## Information We May Collect

We may collect information which you provide through our website (monmouthcoffee.co.uk) when you set up an online account, place an order or when you contact us, whether this be by email, telephone, post or otherwise. The data we may collect includes your name, address and contact details.

If you place an order through our online shop your card details are processed by a third-party payment processor and are not held by us. More information about our third-party payment processor can be found below.

We may also collect technical information including your IP address (a numerical label assigned to your computer that is recorded by our servers when you access the Site), browser type and operating system. We do not store or analyse this data in a way that identifies any individual.

## How We May Use This Information

We may use this information to:

– Process an order you have placed;  
– Carry out our obligations arising from any contracts entered by you and us;  
– Provide you with information or products which you request from us;  
– Verify your identity;  
– Notify you about important changes to our services;  
– Where you have explicitly consented, we may also use your details to send you information about other developments or services that may be of interest to you.

## Disclosure Of Your Information

We will not share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.  
We may disclose your information to:  
third parties if we are under a legal obligation to do so.  
third party service providers to fulfil orders placed through the website, such as Royal Mail, courier services and Global Payments.

## Third Party Payment Providers

We use third-party payment processors Global Payments and PayPal to assist in processing your payment information. Such third-party processors’ use of your personal information is governed by their respective privacy policies which may or may not contain privacy protections as protective as this privacy policy. For more information, you may also want to read Global Payments’ [Privacy Statement](https://www.globalpayments.com/en-gb/privacy-statement) and PayPal’s [Privacy Statement](https://www.paypal.com/uk/legalhub/privacy-full).

## Accessing And Updating Your Information

If you have an account, you can log in to see the information we have stored for you and update your information within your account. You can also ask to have your information by contacting us directly on the details provided below. You can unsubscribe from our email newsletter using the unsubscribe link which can be found in all of our newsletter emails or by contacting us directly.

Like most websites, this Website uses cookies. Cookies are small text files that are sent to your computer when you use a website. By using a cookie or such similar technology we can keep track of your log-in status even if you leave the site and return. A cookie only tracks which computer is logging on to the Website, it does not necessarily identify who is using that computer.

We use the following cookies;  
**Strictly necessary cookies**We use cookies which are strictly necessary to enable you to utilise particular functions of the Website, for example, that enable you to log into secure areas of a website, use a shopping basket or make use of e-payment services.

We use a cookie-free analytics tool called Fathom Analytics to gather information about visitors to the Website. The data collected is irreversibly anonymised and cannot be used to identify a person. For more information about how this works you may want to read [Fathom’s website](https://usefathom.com/data).

## About

### Profile

Fazenda Santa Inês is in Carmo de Minas and part of the Sertão group of coffee farms which are marketed through Carmo Coffee. The farm has 50 hectares planted with coffee and also grows corn, wheat, and soy. The production of corn, wheat, and soy, along with coffee ensures the farm has income across the year. Santa Inês is also home to many avocado, eucalyptus, cedar, orange, and Ipe trees; the last are famous in Brazil for their delightfully bright flowers which arrive just in time for the coffee harvest.

## Grind Guide

### Cafetière

A coarse grind also suitable for cold brew. We use the word cafetière, but this can also be referred to as a French press, plunger or press pot.

### Aeropress slow

Suitable for making a long, filter style coffee, often brewed for a few minutes. Similar to our paper filter setting.

### Filter

This is suitable for our paper filters and ceramic or plastic cones, along with other brands such as V60, Clever dripper and Melitta.

### Stovetop

This is an espresso style grind suitable for use in hob top espresso pots such as a Bialetti or Grunwerg. Sometimes referred to as a moka pot.

### Aeropress fast

This is also an espresso style grind ideal for brewing a short, concentrated, espresso style coffee in an Aeropress.

### Domestic espresso

A fine grind for using in your home espresso machine. Grind requirements will vary depending on brand and model, but this setting aims to work for the majority of home setups.

### Whole beans

For use in your home grinder!

## About

### Profile

The Rungeto Farmer’s Cooperative Society was established in 1997 by 1,150 farmers who, as a group, reinvigorated coffee growing and processing in their local area. They re-opened three processing mills (locally referred to as coffee factories); Kii, Karimikui, and Kiangoi. The cooperative has gone from strength to strength and today has over 7,800 members. We visited Kii earlier this year (2025) meeting with Danson Kangi (Factory Manager) and Samuel Karanja (Rungeto Cooperative Manager) and touring their facilities. Kii Factory is a large mill which processes around ten containers of green coffee a season, this equates to 3000 60kg bags of coffee. Our very small shipment of this coffee is just less than 1% of the total produced! In addition to coffee, many of the growers have dairy cows and deliver milk to Rungeto’s dairy farm. The cooperative society sells milk and dairy products to the local markets.

### Privacy policy

This website is administered by Prufrock Coffee.

Prufrock Coffee is the trading name of Prufrock Coffee Limited (Company no. 07278788). The registered address is 2 Europe Way, Cockermouth, Cumbria, United Kingdom, CA13 0RJ.

We are committed to safeguarding and preserving the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document (the “Policy”) explains what happens to any personal data that you provide to us, or that we collect from you whilst you visit our website and how we use cookies on this website.

By using our website, you’re agreeing to be bound by this Policy.

We may change this Policy from time to time so please check this page occasionally to ensure that you’re happy with any changes.

Any questions regarding this Policy and our privacy practices should be sent by email to: privacy@prufrockcoffee.com or by telephone to +44 (0)20 7242 0467.

#### HOW DO WE COLLECT INFORMATION FROM YOU?

In running and maintaining our website we may collect and process the following data about you:

a. Information provided by you such as: name, email, phone number when you purchase a ticket to an event.  
b. Information that you provide when you communicate with us by any means.  
c. Information that you provide when you register as a user of our guest WiFi services, including but not limited to: name, email address, time and date of usage, data used during session.  
d. Information about your use of our site including details of your visits such as pages viewed and the resources that you access. Such information includes traffic data, location data and other communication data.  
e. Several locations on the website permit you to enter your name and email address to subscribe to our newsletters. With your consent, we can keep you up-to-date on all the latest products, services and news.

#### HOW IS YOUR INFORMATION USED?

We use the information that we collect from you to provide our services to you. In addition to this we may use the information for one or more of the following purposes:

a. To provide information to you that you request from us relating to our products or services.  
b. To process a purchase or order that you have made  
c. To carry out our obligations arising from any contracts entered into by you and us  
d. To seek your views or comments on the services we provide  
e. To provide information to you relating to other products that may be of interest to you. Such additional information will only be provided where you have consented to receive such information. We always provide you the option to opt-out of future emails every time we send you a newsletter  
f. To inform you of any changes to our website, services or goods and products

We do not sell, rent, trade, license or otherwise disclose your specific personal information or financial information to anyone other than to affiliates under Prufrock’s control, except that we sometimes use others to perform specific functions on our behalf.

For example, we partner with Stripe and PayPal to process your orders, therefore you will have to provide them your financial information. If you would rather not send your credit/debit card details over the Internet then please contact us and place your order over the phone by calling us on +44 (0)20 7242 0467.

This website is hosted by Shopify and by using any of Shopify’s Services, or by dealing with a merchant using Shopify’s Services, you are agreeing to the terms of the Shopify Privacy Policy and, as applicable, the Shopify Terms of Service.

#### DISCLOSING YOUR INFORMATION

We will not disclose your personal information to any other party other than in accordance with this Policy and in the circumstances detailed below:

a. In the event that we sell any or all of our business to the buyer.  
b. Where we are legally required by law to disclose your personal information.  
c. To further fraud protection and reduce the risk of fraud.

#### LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING DATA

Consent – By disclosing your personal information to us using this website, you consent to the collection, storage and processing of your personal information by Prufrock in the manner set out in this Policy.

Legitimate interests – if processing is necessary for your interests, for example keeping you informed of our holiday hours, this is done using legitimate interests as a legal basis.

#### RETENTION OF YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION

Personal information that we collect, access or process will be retained only as long as necessary for the fulfilment of the purposes for which it was collected, unless otherwise provided in agreements between you and Prufrock or as required or authorised by law.

Personal information that is no longer required to fulfil the identified purposes will be destroyed, erased or made de-identified.

#### THIRD PARTY SERVICE PROVIDERS WORKING ON OUR BEHALF

We may pass your information to our third party service providers, agents subcontractors and other associated organisations for the purposes of completing tasks and providing services to you on our behalf (for example to register Speciality Coffee Association certificates).

However, when we use third party service providers, we disclose only the personal information that is necessary to deliver the service.

Please be reassured that we will not release your information to third parties outside Prufrock for them to use for their own direct marketing purposes, unless you have requested us to do so.

If you purchase a product from us, your card information is not held by us, it is collected by our third party payment processors, who specialise in the secure online capture and processing of credit/debit card transactions, as explained below.

We may transfer your personal information to a third party as part of a sale of some or all of our business and assets to any third party or as part of any business restructuring or reorganisation, or if we’re under a duty to disclose or share your personal data in order to comply with any legal obligation or to enforce or apply our terms of use or to protect the rights, property or safety of our supporters and customers. However, we will take steps with the aim of ensuring that your privacy rights continue to be protected.

#### YOUR RIGHTS TO ACCESS, CORRECT AND DELETE OR OPT OUT

We respect your right to access and correct your personal information. You may also request that we update your personal information or correct any factual errors that you believe may exist regarding this information.

You may also exercise your rights, subject to applicable laws, to request that we delete or restrict access to your personal data. We may need to retain it for legally permitted purposes and this will be explained to you if necessary.

Upon your request, we will (a) stop sending emails to your email address; and/or (b) disable your account to prevent any future purchases through that account.

If you need assistance correcting or updating your personal information, or would like to request that we delete your personal information, please contact us with your request at privacy@prufrockconsulting.com

We will endeavour to complete all requests for data updates, access or deletion in 30 days.

#### DATA SECURITY

The website incorporates reasonable and appropriate physical, electronic, and administrative procedures to safeguard the confidentiality of your personal information. Access to your personal information is restricted. Only employees who need access to your personal information to perform a specific job are granted access to your personal information.

Non-sensitive details (your email address etc.) are transmitted normally over the Internet, and this can never be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee the security of any information you transmit to us, and you do so at your own risk.

Once we receive your information, we make our best effort to ensure its security on our systems. Where we have given (or where you have chosen) a password which enables you to access certain parts of our website, you are responsible for keeping this password confidential. We ask you not to share your password with anyone.

#### USE OF COOKIES

Cookies provide information regarding the computer used by a visitor. We may use cookies where appropriate to gather information about your computer in order to assist us in improving our website.

We may gather information about your general internet use by using the cookie. Where used, these cookies are downloaded to your computer and stored on the computer’s hard drive. Such information will not identify you personally; it is statistical data which does not identify any personal details whatsoever.

Our advertisers may also use cookies, over which we have no control. Such cookies (if used) would be downloaded once you click on advertisements on our website.

You can adjust the settings on your computer to decline any cookies if you wish. This can be done within the “settings” section of your computer. For more information please read the advice at AboutCookies.org.

#### THIRD PARTY LINKS

Our website may contain links to other websites run by other organisations. This privacy policy applies only to our website‚ so we encourage you to read the privacy statements on the other websites you visit.

We cannot be responsible for the privacy policies and practices of other sites even if you access them using links from our website.

In addition, if you linked to our website from a third party site, we cannot be responsible for the privacy policies and practices of the owners and operators of that third party site and recommend that you check the privacy policy of that third party site.

#### TRANSFERRING YOUR INFORMATION OUTSIDE OF EUROPE

As part of the services offered to you through this website, the information which you provide to us may be transferred to countries outside the European Union (“EU”). By way of example, this may happen if any of our servers are from time to time located in a country outside of the EU.

These countries may not have similar data protection laws to the UK. By submitting your personal data, you’re agreeing to this transfer, storing or processing. If we transfer your information outside of the EU in this way, we will take steps to ensure that appropriate security measures are taken with the aim of ensuring that your privacy rights continue to be protected as outlined in this Policy.

If you use our services while you are outside the EU, your information may be transferred outside the EU in order to provide you with those services.

#### ACCESS BY CHILDREN

This website is not directed toward children under 13 years of age and Prufrock does not knowingly collect or use information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent. If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us promptly as described below, and we will endeavour to investigate and delete such information from our systems.

#### REVIEW OF THIS POLICY

We keep this Policy under regular review. This Policy was last updated in April 2022.

Prix de Flore

**Un bref historique**

Le Prix de Flore fut fondé un jour de mai 1994, autour d’une des tables du Flore, dans le but de couronner un auteur au talent « prometteur ». Les critères de sélection étant l’originalité, la modernité, la jeunesse.

Le Jury, présidé par Frédéric Beigebeder est composé de Jacques Braunstein, Manuel Carcassonne, Carole Chrétiennot, Michèle Fitoussi, Jean-rené Van Der Plaetsen, François Reynaert, Jean-pierre Saccani, Bertrand de Saint-Vincent, Christophe Tison, Philippe Vandel, Arnaud Viviant.

Le jury se distingue par son indépendance, sa liberté, son insolence. C’est au mois de novembre que le Prix est remis lors d’une soirée au café de Flore. Mr Miroslav Siljegovic, président d’honneur, remet au lauréat un chèque de 6100 euros ainsi qu’un verre de Pouilly gravé à son nom, à consommer sans modération durant une année au Flore.

[Découvrez la chaine PRIX DE FLORE](https://www.youtube.com/@prixdeflore4226)

Maria Pourchet

**Le Prix de Flore 2023 est décerné à Maria Pourchet pour son roman « Western » (Stock) au deuxième tour de scrutin par 6 voix contre 4 à « La bague au doigt » d’Eva Ionesco (Robert Laffont) et 1 voix à « L’amour » de François Bégaudeau (Verticales). Manuel Carcassonne, PDG des Éditions Stock, s’est abstenu.**

Dans son roman galopant porté par une écriture éblouissante, Maria Pourchet livre avec un sens de l’humour à la mesure de son sens du tragique, une profonde réflexion sur notre époque, sa violence, sa vulnérabilité, ses rapports difficiles à la liberté et la place qu’elle peut encore laisser au langage amoureux. Maria Pourchet est notamment l’autrice de « Rome en un jour », « Toutes les femmes sauf une » et « Feu ».

Elle succède à Joffrine Donnadieu, lauréate en 2022 pour son roman « Chienne et louve » (Gallimard)

**A propos du Prix de Flore**  
 Fondé en 1994 par Carole Chrétiennot et Frédéric Beigbeder, ce prix récompense depuis sa création un jeune auteur audacieux au talent prometteur qui reçoit un chèque de 6150 euros et le droit de consommer, au Café de Flore, pendant un an chaque jour du Pouilly-fumé dans un verre gravé à son nom. Françoise Sagan avait été la marraine de la première édition.

Le jury est composé de Frédéric Beigbeder, Jacques Braunstein, Manuel Carcassonne, Carole Chrétiennot, Michèle Fitoussi, François Reynaert, Jean-Pierre Saccani, Bertrand de Saint- Vincent, Christophe Tison, Philippe Vandel, Jean-René van der Plaetsen, Arnaud Viviant.
